# Mengke's blog - Mengke's coding journey

> A personal space on the cloud where Mengke, a front-end engineer, documents his programming journey, sharing lessons, insights, and resources for fellow developers. Main topics: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Vue, Next.js, MCP, and web development, plus notes on life.

## Main

- [Home](https://www.mengke.me/): Latest blog posts and snippets
- [Blog](https://www.mengke.me/blog): All blog posts, searchable by title and tag
- [Snippets](https://www.mengke.me/snippets): Short code snippets and notes
- [Projects](https://www.mengke.me/projects): Things Mengke has built
- [About](https://www.mengke.me/about): About the author

## Feeds

- [RSS feed](https://www.mengke.me/feed.xml): Full list of blog posts as a feed
- [Sitemap](https://www.mengke.me/sitemap.xml): All public pages on the site

## Author

- [GitHub](https://github.com/mk965): The author's GitHub profile; this site's source is at https://github.com/mk965/mengke.me
